match.title: Kathmandu Gorkhas v Chitwan Rhinos
match.venue: Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur

insights.text: Chitwan Rhinos win 65% of our simulations.

Kathmandu Gorkhas's first wicket most likely falls around over 2; R Dhakal is the likeliest to take it (28%).
Jahandad Khan is Kathmandu Gorkhas's likeliest top scorer (24%), with a 30% chance of 30+.

Chitwan Rhinos's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; Jahandad Khan is the likeliest to take it (18%).
DJ Malan is Chitwan Rhinos's likeliest top scorer (30%), with a 44% chance of 30+.
Jahandad Khan leads Kathmandu Gorkhas's attack: 28% chance of 2+ wickets.
